items.title: Exciting New MiniMax H3 Video Service Added in Platform Service 🎥
items.summary: This update introduces the `POST /minimax/videos` endpoint, enabling the generation of MiniMax H3 videos with text, image, and audio guidance. Key enhancements include normalized async tasks, improved billing duration, and error handling, along with deployment to AceDataCloud CDN. Additionally, an isolated workload for the MiniMax service has been deployed, complete with contract tests in CI to ensure reliability.

items.title: Enhance Submit Action Handling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a bug in the `<xhs-publish-btn>` component where the click action was incorrectly biased towards the save action. The fix introduces a click bias that prioritizes the end-side click for submit actions, ensuring that the correct action is triggered. All tests have passed successfully, confirming the reliability of the changes.

items.title: Streamline Native Protocol Paths in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the native Chat, Responses, and Messages requests for improved efficiency by preparing and normalizing them only once at the client boundary. It introduces the `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens` route with proxy authentication and public-model alias resolution while retaining the existing Chat-to-Responses bridge. The changes enhance performance and maintain compatibility without altering existing model routing behaviors.

items.title: Enhance email overview by separating active and historical queues in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where the email campaign overview inaccurately counted stale queued recipients from cancelled campaigns. The fix introduces a new aggregation for active recipients, specifically for campaigns that are currently running, while preserving historical data for backward compatibility. Additionally, regression tests have been added to ensure that cancelled campaigns do not appear in the active queue.

items.title: Enhance Email Delivery Status Clarity in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the email campaign overview by clearly distinguishing the global sending switch from active delivery. The banner now accurately reflects whether campaigns are currently delivering, and the queued recipients are sourced from the backend. Additionally, all locales have been updated to ensure consistent messaging across different languages.

items.title: Enhance Email Settings Visuals in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update refines the email settings page by consolidating the readiness status and global sending toggle into a more compact area, reducing visual noise. It also implements a true three-column layout for provider, sender address, and sending domain, ensuring long addresses wrap safely. Additionally, the layout is optimized for responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, while cleaning up outdated styles.

items.title: Enhance Solana Payments with Buffer Polyfill in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a browser `Buffer` implementation to support Solana payments. It adds `buffer` as a direct runtime dependency and updates the X402 order contract check to ensure compatibility with the polyfill and the current client version. These changes enhance the reliability of payment processing on the platform.

items.title: Enhance CORS Support for Discord Proxy in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update allows authenticated Discord proxy calls from 'https://platform.acedata.cloud' while ensuring valid browser preflight requests are processed without compromising bearer token protection. Additionally, regression tests have been added to cover both preflight and authenticated responses, enhancing the reliability of the service.

items.title: Refine Discount Badge Logic in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update improves the purchase page by ensuring that the discount badge is only displayed when the per-unit price is below 100%. The logic was adjusted to prevent misleading information for packages with equal pricing. All relevant tests have passed, confirming the stability of the changes.

items.title: Enhance Message Streaming Reliability in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a mechanism to emit valid 'ping' events for Anthropic Messages when upstream streams are idle, preventing timeouts. The idle timer is reset with each real chunk received, and heartbeat timers are cleaned up on various terminal events. Additionally, the heartbeat interval can now be configured, enhancing the stability of message streaming.

items.title: Enhance Template Wizard for Scheduled Tasks in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update automatically opens the template wizard when the `/chatgpt/scheduled` route includes a `template_category`, specifically preserving the marketing category from the referral-center CTA. Direct visits remain unaffected. The changes have been validated with successful tests and lint checks.

items.title: Enhance Template Testing and Delivery in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update tightens the testing gates for scheduled templates by ensuring omitted versions resolve to the latest catalog version and requiring concrete artifact evidence for controlled delivery templates. Personal WeChat and Blogger tests remain in draft mode, and the unattended template no longer has write capabilities, producing a reviewable message draft instead. These changes improve the reliability and safety of template management.

items.title: Enhance WebSocket Connection Handling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the WebSocket connection handling by introducing a distinct lifecycle model, allowing immediate feedback upon connection establishment. Users will now see a '101 · Connected' message right away, along with a waiting-for-events state. Additionally, the update ensures that all server frames are appended with their receive times and enhances error handling for connection issues.

items.title: Fix relay recovery serialization to prevent errors in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical bug where simultaneous reconnect and watchdog alarms could lead to a `BootstrapAlreadyUsedError`. The fix involves serializing the `reconnect` and `ensureConnected` processes within the DeviceRelay, ensuring that only one socket is created per bootstrap. Comprehensive tests confirm the effectiveness of this solution, enhancing the stability of the connection process.

items.title: Introducing a Sleek New GitHub Proxy 2 in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces an isolated `github-proxy2` candidate that wraps `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.14.17`, enhancing the handling of Chat, Responses, and Messages. Key features include a direct bridge for Responses-only models and a focus on maintaining child usage without the need for a database or billing engine. The deployment ensures a smooth transition while preserving existing functionalities of the `github-proxy`.

items.title: Enhance Heartbeat Mechanism for MV3 Watchdog in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a bug where the MV3 Browser Agent socket's heartbeat was not sent due to Chrome suspending the timer. The fix modifies the existing watchdog to ensure a client heartbeat is sent, maintaining session policies while improving connection reliability. Verification tests have confirmed the effectiveness of the changes.

items.title: Enhance Browser Resource Handling in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a mechanism to derive safe filename extensions from receipt MIME types for browser resources. It sets the `Content-Disposition` header to ensure proper file naming during downloads, while also keeping unknown MIME types extensionless for security. Key tests have been added to verify these changes, enhancing the reliability of file handling in the application.

items.title: Enhance file input verification in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of controlled file inputs by dispatching composed input and change events after file selection. It ensures that the actual `input.files` list is accurately read back, preventing issues where the upload screen remains active despite successful API calls. The extension has been published as version 0.7.37 with enhanced testing coverage.

items.title: Enhance File Upload Notifications in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces native-equivalent bubbling `input` and `change` events after using `DOM.setFileInputFiles`, ensuring that controlled uploaders respond correctly. The extension has been published as version 0.7.36, maintaining all existing checks for resources. Comprehensive testing has confirmed that all unit tests passed successfully.

items.title: Enhance Resource Management in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of staged browser upload resources across LLM turns in a single API request. It ensures that snapshot-first publish flows retain their upload credentials, preventing data loss. Additionally, a regression test has been added to verify the functionality, ensuring robust performance in production.

items.title: Enhance Telegram Management in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a dedicated management interface for Telegram instances within the Deployment Manage page. Key features include embedded QR/2FA controls, streamlined subscription billing visibility, and focused configuration for initial deployments. The changes aim to improve user experience and operational efficiency for Telegram integrations.

items.title: New Telegram Subscription Plans in Backend 🤖
items.summary: This update introduces new 1, 7, and 30-day subscription plans for Telegram at competitive prices. The deployment subscription gating is now data-driven based on linked period packages, while free Helm deployments remain accessible without a linked package. Additionally, the Telegram seed script has been updated for reproducibility.

items.title: Enhance Hermes UI Component Registration in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update fixes the registration of Element Plus components in the Hermes UI, specifically in `Hermes.vue` and `HermesDashboardCard.vue`. By explicitly importing and registering the necessary components, the visual layout issues have been resolved, ensuring that the model catalog renders correctly within the UI. Additionally, a new contract has been added to enforce proper component registration for future development.

items.title: Update Browser Extension Requirement in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update requires the Browser Agent version 0.7.35 in both settings and production environments. It ensures consistency in deployment configurations and updates the relevant tests to reflect this change. The deployment will only proceed once PlatformFrontend 0.7.35 is available on the CDN.

items.title: Enhance SEO with Dynamic OG Images in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces dynamic Open Graph and Twitter image metadata for tenant-specific URLs, ensuring crawlers receive the correct information without executing JavaScript. The static SPA placeholder has been replaced with an nginx rewrite, and runtime SEO updates are now consolidated on the share-card endpoint. These changes aim to improve the visibility and branding of tenant sites.

items.title: Enhance origin recovery after timeout in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of timed-out navigations by reconciling them with Chrome’s final live URL. It ensures that verified allowed origins are preserved for future snapshots, while unknown destinations are marked as 'unsettled'. The extension has been updated to version 0.7.35, enhancing stability and user experience.

items.title: Enhance WebSocket Auth Documentation in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update clarifies the WebSocket authentication process by documenting the correct HTTP response codes. The handshake result for invalid tokens is now accurately noted as `403 Forbidden`, while valid tokens will still result in `101 Switching Protocols`. Additionally, tests have been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring robust validation of the API's behavior.

items.title: Enhance Open Graph Card Generation in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a public endpoint for generating white-label Open Graph images, supporting both Chinese and English localizations. Key changes include the addition of a deterministic caching mechanism, a new orbit field for capability icons, and restrictions on remote logo downloads to approved CDN hosts. The implementation has been validated with extensive testing, ensuring reliability and performance.

items.title: Streamline Daily Release Process in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new daily aggregation process for Beachball/npm/GitHub releases, enhancing efficiency by reducing the frequency of releases to once per day. Key changes include maintaining automatic web deployments on every merge while holding GitHub Releases as drafts until all assets are attached. The independent mobile testing schedule has also been adjusted to follow the new release window.

items.title: GLM CLI Alignment Verified in Clis 🚀
items.summary: The synchronization process confirmed that the GLM CLI is fully aligned with the current GLM OpenAPI specification. Key endpoints, including `/glm/chat/completions`, and model choices, such as `glm-5.2`, have been validated. The updates to the documentation do not affect the existing OpenAPI file or propose any changes to source or tests.

items.title: GLM MCP Sync Verified with Docs OpenAPI in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: The GLM service has been successfully reviewed against the current Docs OpenAPI contract following the upstream sync. Key confirmations include alignment of the `POST /glm/chat/completions` path and matching enums for model, `reasoning_effort`, and `service_tier`. All top-level request fields are correctly exposed and forwarded by the MCP client.

items.title: Update GLM Model List in Clis 🚀
items.summary: The GLM documentation has been updated to include `glm-5.2` as the latest flagship model. The README now reflects the current OpenAPI model enum, showcasing `glm-5.2`, `glm-5`, and `glm-5-turbo`. Additionally, the quick-start example has been revised to demonstrate the use of `glm-5.2` for enhanced clarity.

items.title: GLM MCP Validation Complete in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: The GLM MCP has been successfully validated against the updated AceDataCloud Docs OpenAPI specification. Key checks confirmed that the `/glm/chat/completions` path and all 29 request properties align perfectly with the client interface, ensuring no changes are necessary for compatibility.

items.title: Enhance Private Hermes Deployment Service in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update completes the private Hermes Deployment Service, ensuring no duplicate services are created. Key changes include the addition of stable Hermes icon and banner assets, translation keys for service details, and an updated integration guide. The service remains private, with no packages available, maintaining existing credential and billing paths.

items.title: Launch of Guided Template Center in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new guided template center for scheduled tasks, allowing users to create templates through a five-step wizard. Key features include reusing existing connector infrastructure, ensuring tasks remain disabled until successful testing, and localized content across multiple languages. The implementation is backed by extensive testing and validation to enhance user experience.

items.title: Enhance AI Chat with Scheduled Task Templates in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a catalog of ten official scheduled-task templates for AI Chat, enhancing the existing scheduled-task endpoint with new actions like list, detail, and instantiate. It ensures that template instances remain disabled until they pass a manual test, promoting a robust testing process. Additionally, the platform-scheduler now respects a paused create status, improving task management.

items.title: Enhance session model handling in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of model selectors in Coding Bridge sessions by normalizing the `model_selector` field and ensuring that the correct launch selector is preserved during session resumption. Key changes include the introduction of a versioned selector provenance contract and adjustments to session state management, which prevents legacy resolved IDs from overriding explicit selectors. All tests have passed successfully, confirming the robustness of these changes.

items.title: Streamline Selector Management in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the session runtime state to exclusively use `model_selector`, removing the legacy `model` and `model_contract` fields. The changes enhance clarity by ensuring that only the resolved model is emitted, improving compatibility and reducing ambiguity in session data. All relevant tests have passed, confirming the stability of these modifications.

items.title: Enhance Telegram Bot with Assets and Landing Page in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update adds display assets for the existing Telegram Bot service, including an icon and thumbnail, ensuring users see the correct visuals in their application list. Additionally, the placeholder Markdown introduction has been replaced with a responsive bilingual landing page, improving user experience. The seed script has also been updated to maintain idempotency.

items.title: Update Browser Agent Minimum Version in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update raises the minimum required version of the Browser Agent to 0.7.34, ensuring compatibility with the latest features. The deployment settings have been adjusted accordingly, and tests have been verified with all passing. This change will enhance the overall stability and performance of the application.

items.title: Streamline Promotion Templates in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update removes all growth and referral-specific elements from the scheduled template design, transforming promotion templates into standard templates that utilize the AceDataCloud MCP. Key changes include the elimination of fields like `growth`, `growth_capability`, and `referral_enabled`, ensuring a more generic and streamlined approach to template creation and usage.

items.title: Enhance Publish Control Verification in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a requirement for a fresh semantic Publish reference after final confirmation, preventing append-style recovery after field drift or failed writes. It also tightens the success proof criteria to ensure explicit success states, published destinations, or new note IDs. The changes improve the reliability of the publishing process in the Skills area.

items.title: Enhance Custom Publish Controls in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces visible declarative custom submit widgets through the existing semantic reference system, ensuring compliance with session and hit-test enforcement. The CDN extension has been bumped to version 0.7.34, and the `<xhs-publish-btn>` shape is now fully covered. These changes improve accessibility and functionality for the Browser Agent.

items.title: Enhance GLM Chat Options for OpenAPI Compatibility in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes GLM chat options with the latest OpenAPI schema, adding several new parameters for enhanced functionality. Key additions include options for max completion tokens, reasoning effort, service tier, and more, all of which are now supported in the GLM CLI. Comprehensive tests have also been added to ensure the new features work seamlessly.

items.title: Verify Docs Sync Status for GLM in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update confirms that the GLM MCP server is in sync with the upstream OpenAPI contract, ensuring that the model enum, request parameters, endpoint path, and supported option enums are accurate. It also notes that there are no local MCP server directories for the `claude-code` and `codex` services, as well as no matching OpenAPI specs for these services. No source changes were necessary for this verification.

items.title: Enhance Codex Authentication and Coze Integration Guide in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update clarifies the Codex authentication modes and introduces a comprehensive guide for integrating Coze custom models. Key changes include explicit documentation of evidence boundaries, updates to the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` guidance, and the addition of contract tests to prevent authentication and protocol drift. Overall, these enhancements aim to improve user experience and reliability in the integration process.

items.title: Enhance WebSocket API Documentation in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces significant improvements to the WebSocket API documentation. Key changes include the integration of bearer/API-key authentication, generation of WebSocket examples in JavaScript and Python, and the ability to connect/disconnect browser-compatible WebSockets. These enhancements ensure a more robust and user-friendly experience across deployment documentation and API code dialogs.

items.title: Enhance Terminal Pod Security in Backend 🔒
items.summary: This update improves the security of terminal pod access by validating client-selected pods against the application's release selector. It ensures that only authorized containers can be accessed, preventing unauthorized access to other tenants' pods. The changes include modifications to the terminal consumer logic and the addition of new tests for authentication and pod isolation.

items.title: Streamlined WeChat Agent Setup with Step-by-Step Guide in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces the previous terminal-based WeChat AI setup with a user-friendly four-step guide using Element Plus. The new guide includes concise Markdown instructions, copyable commands, and safety tips, all translated into supported locales. Additionally, a regression contract test has been added to ensure functionality across all steps.

items.title: Enhance Hermes Workflow for Chart Releases in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes direct writes from the PlatformService CI into the Service table owned by PlatformBackend, ensuring a clearer boundary. The Hermes workflow is now focused on validating and publishing OCI artifacts, with documentation clarifying that Service metadata updates occur only after package verification. Additionally, a contract has been added to prevent future coupling with `PGSQL_*` and metadata sync.

items.title: Enhance Terminal Authentication Security in Backend 🔒
items.summary: This update improves terminal authentication by replacing unverified JWT payload decoding with robust signature and expiry validation. It ensures that platform-token expiry is checked before accepting connections and logs failures without exposing token contents. These changes significantly enhance security by preventing the forging of unsigned JWTs for unauthorized terminal access.

items.title: Enhance TikTok Connector Draft Capabilities in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the TikTok connector by stopping the advertisement of unaudited Direct Post capabilities. It ensures that connector suggestions now trigger a confirmed inbox/draft upload while retaining the necessary `video.publish` permission, clearly labeled with its audit gate. These changes enhance user clarity and functionality within the TikTok integration.

items.title: Enhance TikTok Draft Upload Reliability in Skills 🤖
items.summary: This update improves the TikTok integration by ensuring reliable draft uploads through a new confirmation process. A standard-library helper has been added for single-chunk file uploads and status polling. The changes affect three files, enhancing functionality while keeping direct posting disabled pending an audit.

items.title: Enhance CORS Handling for Platform Requests in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a CORS issue that prevented the platform console from successfully making POST requests to the `/api/auth/qr` endpoint. By wrapping the Bearer middleware with a CORS layer, the OPTIONS preflight now receives the correct response, allowing for seamless authentication while maintaining security for anonymous POST requests. All tests have passed successfully, ensuring stability.

items.title: Enhance billing accuracy for aichat2 streams in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update fixes a critical issue where non-BYOK aichat2 conversations recorded zero completion tokens, leading to HTTP 500 errors in billing. The fix involves enabling usage tracking for internal LLM calls and ensuring that scheduled runs can access accumulated usage data. Regression tests have been added to maintain coverage and ensure stability.

items.title: Deploying the New Hermes Chart in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update moves the Hermes per-tenant Helm chart source under the PlatformService repository and maintains the existing OCI contract for production. A new chart release workflow has been added, along with necessary contracts for rendering and Kubernetes dry-run. The deployment process ensures that the existing release remains online during the migration, enhancing the overall deployment strategy.

items.title: Refine Scheduled Task Templates in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the scheduled-template plan boundary by ensuring that all template definitions and related tasks remain within the aichat2 scope. Key changes include the removal of PlatformBackend components from the initial phases and a streamlined implementation order focusing on PlatformService and Nexior. These adjustments aim to enhance the clarity and functionality of the scheduled tasks.

items.title: Clarify Action Confirmation Messages in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the confirmation message for actions to indicate that they are in progress rather than already completed. The change affects 19 files, including updates to 18 locale files to ensure consistency across all supported languages. No changes were made to runtime behavior, and all tests have passed successfully.

items.title: Enhance Action Confirmation Validation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new validation mechanism for action confirmations, recognizing them as distinct paused-input types. Key changes include validating JSON structure, confirmation IDs, and handling idempotency conflicts for repeated submissions. The implementation affects two files, enhancing the conversation handler and adding focused tests to ensure reliability.

items.title: Update Telegrambot PVC Size for Tencent CBS in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update raises the Telegram session PVC size from 1Gi to the Tencent CBS minimum of 10Gi. This change addresses a failure encountered with the first tenant PVC, ensuring compliance with the required disk size range. The OCI chart version 0.1.2 has been published with this correction.

items.title: Enhance Email Audiences by Excluding Restricted Accounts in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a migration to mirror the `is_restricted` status from AuthBackend into email audience profiles. Restricted accounts are now excluded from all audience-related processes, improving the accuracy of audience counts and targeting. Additionally, regression tests have been added to ensure the integrity of the sync and audience refresh functionalities.

items.title: Enhance Email Draft Flow and Progress Feedback in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the email campaign composer by keeping the draft flow open after saving, ensuring the send option is always available. A new localized progress overlay has been added to inform users when sending is in progress, while navigation and duplicate actions are disabled during backend operations. Additionally, interaction contract tests have been implemented and translations for all locales have been completed.

items.title: Update aichat model choices to align with Docs OpenAPI in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the aichat CLI model choices with the latest changes in the Docs OpenAPI specification. Removed models that are no longer present in the spec have been eliminated from the `MODELS2` list, and new tests have been added to ensure these models do not appear in the output. Additionally, validation tests confirm that attempts to use removed models are properly rejected.

items.title: Enhance Security by Redacting Helm Secrets in Logs in Backend 🔒
items.summary: This update improves security by redacting sensitive Helm arguments in logs, specifically those passed with `--set-string`, `--set-json`, and `--set-file`. The actual command execution remains unchanged, ensuring useful diagnostics while preventing exposure of secrets. Comprehensive tests have been added and successfully passed to verify the changes.

items.title: Ensure AiChat MCP Sync with Updated Docs in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies the synchronization of the AiChat MCP with the latest upstream documentation. Key endpoints such as `/aichat/conversations` and `/aichat2/conversations` were confirmed to be accurately represented, with no changes required to the repository. The contract coverage, including model enums and request parameters, aligns with the current specifications.

items.title: Enhance Deployment Service Audit and Roadmap in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive audit of the Deployment Service control plane, covering critical components like PlatformBackend and Kubernetes. Key findings include 2 critical and 6 high-severity issues, alongside a phased roadmap for security remediation and system enhancements. The plan is now indexed in the README for better visibility and tracking.

items.title: Ensure valid IANA time zones for scheduled tasks in Platform Service ⏰
items.summary: This update adds strict validation for scheduled task time zones in the aichat2 module, accepting only valid IANA zones like Asia/Shanghai, America/Los_Angeles, and UTC. It rejects missing, fixed-offset, or unknown zones before saving or scheduling tasks. Comprehensive tests now cover both cron and interval schedule validations, improving reliability and preventing scheduling errors.

items.title: Enhance Time Zone Documentation for Scheduled Tasks in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the documentation for scheduled tasks by detailing the IANA time-zone selector and its implications. It clarifies that saved time zones remain fixed, ensuring consistent wall-clock semantics for both cloud and local executions. Additionally, it explains the behavior of Daylight Saving Time and the use of jitter in cloud tasks, while local tasks operate without it.

items.title: Enhance Scheduled Tasks with Time Zone Support in Nexior 🌍
items.summary: This update introduces an explicit IANA time-zone picker for scheduled tasks, allowing users to select and display their preferred time zones. It ensures that tasks honor the saved time zone during desktop-local cron scheduling, including daylight saving time transitions. Additionally, the update includes validation for locale coverage and adds focused tests for the UI and scheduling functionalities.

items.title: Enhanced Remediation and Growth Plan for ACE in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive ACE remediation and growth plan based on the latest production audit. Key changes include the registration of two new P0 defects, improved documentation for compliance, and a focus on establishing a single canonical ACE roadmap. The plan aims to enhance operational transparency and ensure effective implementation across various platforms.

items.title: Fix Telegram Migration Conflict in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update renumbers the unapplied Telegram service data migration from `0260` to `0262` to resolve conflicts with concurrent releases. It ensures that the production environment correctly applies the Telegram Service/API rows by depending on the current migration head. The changes have been verified against the production migration table.

items.title: Streamline Deployment Controls in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update removes manual scaling controls from the deployment management page, simplifying the user interface. Additionally, obsolete frontend API client methods and component states have been eliminated, while maintaining read-only replica health status across all locales. These changes enhance the overall user experience and reduce complexity in deployment management.

items.title: Streamline Deployment by Disabling Manual Scaling in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the public manual scaling endpoint for deployments, ensuring a more streamlined process. Provider-level scaling remains intact for subscription expiry suspension and renewal recovery. A new route regression test has been added to confirm the old endpoint is no longer accessible.

items.title: Enhance WeChat WebSocket API Documentation in Backend 🤖
items.summary: This update registers the WeChat bot WebSocket stream as an appliance API documentation entry. It includes the generation of an OpenAPI 3 WebSocket handshake contract with authentication and event schema. Additionally, focused tests have been added to ensure the integrity of the generated specifications and migration mapping.

items.title: Introducing Telegram QR Login Wizard in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update adds a Telegram-specific deployment wizard for tenants, enabling QR login and 2FA password management. Users will only see MCP/Bearer credentials after successful authentication, enhancing security. Additionally, complete translations have been implemented across all supported locales to ensure accessibility.

items.title: Updated Kimi Code Icon in Backend 🎨
items.summary: This update replaces the Kimi Code sidebar icon with a new transparent-background PNG. A reversible data migration has been implemented to ensure the live Document reflects this change seamlessly.

items.title: Enhance Model Selector Provenance in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces significant improvements to how model selectors are handled in the Coding Bridge. Key changes include versioning the sidecar model contract and separating the model selector from the resolved model ID, ensuring accurate context during cross-device resumes. Additionally, legacy model values are treated as ambiguous to prevent incorrect assumptions, enhancing overall reliability.

items.title: Deploy Telegram Account Proxy Service in Backend 🤖
items.summary: This update introduces a new public Telegram personal-account Deployment Service, complete with QR-login REST OpenAPI contracts and cost rules. Additionally, it includes scripts for reproducible service specifications and bilingual documentation to enhance user accessibility. The changes aim to streamline the integration of personal Telegram accounts with AI and automation tools.

items.title: Enhance Telegram Bot with Per-Tenant Proxy in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a per-tenant Telethon account proxy, enabling QR and 2FA login for enhanced security. Key features include Bearer-protected MCP and REST account operations, along with session persistence on a single-replica PVC. Additionally, an OCI Helm chart has been added to facilitate deployment using the shared nginx-router ingress.

items.title: Enhance Signup Controls for Better Security in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new 10-per-24h limit on domain signups, complementing the existing 5-per-hour controls. The signup-abuse review pipeline will now run every four hours instead of daily, improving response times to potential abuse. Additionally, the term 'credits_reclaimed' has been updated to 'credits_frozen' to better reflect the status of disabled applications.

items.title: Enhance Chat Handling for Production Parity in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update restores production native parity by ensuring the forced Responses model list is honored, even when the Copilot catalog overclaims Chat support. Key changes include adjusting the handling of `max_completion_tokens` to align with child-compatible requests and implementing extensive regression tests to validate the fixes. The modifications aim to improve the reliability of Chat interactions in production environments.

items.title: Enhance Contract Compatibility in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update enforces full contract compatibility by deriving and pinning a comprehensive OpenAI/Anthropic contract surface, including 1,836 atoms and various operational workflows. Key changes include the addition of legacy functions, improved semantic postconditions, and a shift to capability-based routing for requests. These enhancements aim to prevent misleading HTTP responses and ensure robust handling of diverse operational scenarios.

items.title: Improve webhook response handling and task ID extraction in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances webhook delivery by preserving the full response body for protocol parsing while continuing to log only a truncated snippet for display. It also fixes the Wisdom task-id extraction for durable announcement delivery. These changes improve reliability and debugging capabilities in webhook processing.

items.title: Register private Hermes deployment service with secure tenant credentials in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a private Hermes Deployment Service using the Helm provider, featuring auto-provisioned global credentials and isolated secrets for Dashboard and API access. Tenant access is restricted to the Dashboard password, while model and signing secrets remain privileged. The change includes new migration scripts, enhanced deployment contracts, and comprehensive tests to ensure secure and reliable service deployment. Documentation for the private hosted beta flow has also been added.

items.title: Enhance Hermes Deployment Wizard and Dashboard Access in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a three-step deployment wizard for Hermes, enhancing user experience with a streamlined setup process. Additionally, a new Dashboard credential card has been added, ensuring model and API signing secrets remain secure. The update also includes comprehensive localization support with maintained translations across multiple languages.

items.title: Enhance metadata sync handling in Deployment Hermes 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the metadata synchronization process to skip syncing if the Hermes Service is not yet registered. This change prevents release failures after a successful OCI push, ensuring smoother deployments. The published chart has been verified to work correctly with the new logic.

items.title: Fix GHCR Login with Actions Token in Deployment Hermes 🚀
items.summary: Updated the release workflow to use the repository-scoped Actions token for GHCR login, replacing the unset `GHCR_TOKEN` secret. This change addresses the login failure encountered during the first release attempt, ensuring smoother deployments moving forward.

items.title: Exciting New Hermes Agent Deployment Chart in Deployment Hermes 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a dedicated per-tenant Hermes Agent StatefulSet chart, enhancing deployment capabilities for AceDataCloud. Key features include persistent state storage under `/opt/data`, a password-protected Dashboard via `nginx-router`, and seamless integration of model and dashboard secrets from Kubernetes. The chart has been published to GHCR and is ready for production use.

items.title: Revamp Routes for Enhanced Navigation in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update swaps the routes for the capability-first product presentation and the white-label business presentation. The `/home` route now leads to capabilities, while `/business` covers branding and pricing. All changes have been verified with successful regression tests and no errors across routes.

items.title: Enhance Announcement Delivery with Webhooks in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the `announcement.published` webhook event and improves delivery reliability by persisting per-destination deliveries with retry and idempotency. Scheduled announcements are now dispatched via a CronJob, and ordinary edits to published announcements will no longer be re-broadcasted. Comprehensive tests have been added to ensure functionality and reliability.

items.title: Enhance Discord Webhook Message Handling in Platform Service 🤖
items.summary: This update introduces deduplication for Discord webhook messages by honoring the `Idempotency-Key` on the proxy message endpoint. It ensures that repeated announcement requests return the original delivery result while preserving the existing error mapping. The changes have been validated with all tests passing successfully.

items.title: Enhance Announcement Broadcasting Features in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces an authenticated announcement broadcast endpoint that sends messages to configured WeChat groups while ensuring idempotency by deduplicating repeated announcement IDs. It also includes new tests to validate the functionality and robustness of the announcement broadcasting process. The production announcement appliance must be upgraded to this build before enabling the webhook.

items.title: Align kimi CLI with Latest OpenAPI Updates in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the `kimi` CLI with the latest OpenAPI documentation, ensuring command definitions and options are accurately reflected. Key changes include adjustments to command descriptions and help text, as well as updates to command options for consistency with the API contract. Targeted tests have also been added to validate the new command behaviors and request mappings.

items.title: Align CLI with Latest OpenAPI Updates in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update syncs the `suno` CLI with the latest OpenAPI changes, ensuring command coverage and request mappings are accurate. Key adjustments include aligning command help text with operation summaries and maintaining backward compatibility with minimal changes. The update enhances clarity in spec-to-CLI mappings, reducing ambiguity for users.

items.title: Ensure Kimi Docs Sync is Unaffected in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies that the Kimi Docs sync does not require any changes to the MCPs. The scope was confirmed by checking that the `openapi/kimi.json` defines the necessary endpoint without any local Kimi server needing updates. All unrelated MCP packages remain unchanged.
